anomalies.description: A group of uniformed personnel deploy tear gas or smoke canisters into a street crowd, causing dispersal and visible smoke plume; civilians and officers are in motion amid unrest.

A group of individuals, some in dark tactical gear and others in civilian clothing, are engaged in a chaotic street confrontation. Smoke is visible in the background (e.g., f0, f1), suggesting use of tear gas or similar. People are running, scattering, and moving aggressively; one individual in the foreground (f0–f2) runs with what appears to be a firearm. The scene shows collective violent unrest with multiple parties clashing or dispersing under tension.; A group of individuals, some in dark uniforms (possibly security forces), are engaged in a chaotic street confrontation with civilians. Debris is scattered on the road, people are running, and smoke appears in later frames (from ~97s onward), indicating escalation consistent with a riot or violent unrest.

A group of uniformed personnel (likely security forces) are engaged in a confrontation with civilians on a street; smoke is visible in the background, and individuals are seen running, throwing objects, and adopting aggressive postures consistent with violent unrest.

In frames f13–f15, a person in dark clothing (left side of frame) is seen in a stance consistent with firing a handgun, with an apparent muzzle flash or puff of smoke near their hand at 99.0s (f14). This suggests a discharge of a firearm, though the weapon itself is not clearly resolved.
Two young men (one in red shirt, one in white/red striped shirt) engage in a physical confrontation, with visible pushing and grappling near a bench in an open plaza area.

A man in a green/white/yellow shirt is restrained by two uniformed officers; he appears to be holding or shielding a small child (in pink), who is passive and not resisting—suggesting the adult is being subdued while protecting or carrying a helpless minor, constituting abuse of the adult’s situation and potential endangerment of the child.

A large group of people is seen running, scattering, and reacting to a sudden cloud of white smoke (visible from f13 onward); armed officers in tactical gear are present, and civilians flee in disorganized fashion—indicating collective violent unrest or dispersal due to crowd control measures (e.g., tear gas), meeting the definition of riot.

A crowd of civilians and uniformed officers are in a state of unrest in a public plaza; smoke (likely from tear gas or similar) appears at 130.5s, people begin running and scattering, and by 135.0s the scene shows chaotic movement with multiple individuals fleeing and officers advancing, indicating collective violent unrest.

A large crowd surrounds and aggressively confronts a white van, with multiple individuals pushing, pulling, and striking the vehicle; some raise arms in apparent protest or aggression, and papers are scattered on the road, indicating chaotic unrest.

At least two pairs of individuals engage in close physical combat amid the crowd near the van: one pair grapples near the front left wheel (visible in f6–f8), and another appears to exchange blows near center frame (f9–f10).

Multiple individuals are seen physically grappling near the front of the white van in early frames; one person in red is pushed or struck, and others engage in close-contact struggles amid the crowd surge.

In the early frames, individuals near the front of the crowd engage in physical altercations: one person in a white shirt is seen raising arms aggressively toward another, and there is visible shoving and grappling among several participants near the van and street center.

A group of people are actively vandalizing a white delivery truck, climbing on it, pulling at its side panels, and throwing debris (including papers) into the air. The scene shows collective violent unrest with multiple individuals engaged in destructive behavior against property, consistent with a riot.
